 RPSC PROTECTION OFFICER ADMIT CARD 2026 OUT 
 RPSC Protection Officer Admit Card 2026 Out, Direct Link
 RPSC has released the Protection Officer Admit Card 2026 on November 12, 2026. The written exam will be conducted on November 15, 2026, in two shifts. Candidates can download the hall ticket using their application number and date of birth. Khushi Priya 12 Nov, 2026 Share

 The Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the RPSC Protection Officer Admit Card 2026 on November 12, 2026. The hall ticket has been issued for the Protection Officer Competitive Examination 2025, which is being conducted for recruitment to the Protection Officer post under the Women and Child Development Department, Rajasthan.
 Candidates who are appearing for the examination can download their admit cards through the Rajasthan State Recruitment Portal using their application number and date of birth. The written examination is scheduled for November 15, 2026, and will be held in two shifts in offline OMR-based mode.   
 Candidates can also check UPSC ESE Exam Date 2027 and the complete Prelims schedule, shift timings and exam details. Check UPSC ESE Exam Date 2027 .

 RPSC Protection Officer Admit Card 2026 Download Link
 The admit card download facility is available through the Rajasthan State Recruitment Portal. Candidates can access their hall ticket by entering their application number and date of birth.
  RPSC Protection Officer Admit Card 2026 Direct Link 
 Candidates can use the Rajasthan Recruitment Portal to download the hall ticket. Candidates can also check KMAT 2026 Admit Card download details, exam date and instructions for the examination day. 
 How to Download RPSC Protection Officer Admit Card 2026?
 Candidates can follow the steps below to download the RPSC Protection Officer Hall Ticket 2026:
 Visit the official Rajasthan Recruitment Portal at recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in.
 Go to the admit card download section.
 Select the RPSC Protection Officer Competitive Examination 2025.
 Enter the application number and date of birth.
 Enter the CAPTCHA code displayed on the screen.
 Click on the Get Admit Card option.
 The RPSC Protection Officer Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Check all the details mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Download the admit card and take a clear printout for the examination.   
 Candidates can also check  AFCAT 1 Apply Online 2027 details, including the application dates, eligibility, vacancies and direct application link.
 Details Mentioned on RPSC Protection Officer Hall Ticket 2026
 After downloading the admit card, candidates should carefully check the information printed on it. The hall ticket contains details such as:
 Candidate’s Name
 Roll Number and Application Number
 Examination Name
 Candidate’s Photograph
 Examination Date
 Paper-wise Examination Timings
 Reporting Time
 Examination Centre Name and Address
 Important Exam Day Instructions
 If candidates find any discrepancy in the admit card, they should contact the concerned authorities before the examination date. Candidates can also check SSC GD PET Admit Card 2026 download details, PET/PST schedule and important exam instructions. 
 Documents Required for RPSC Protection Officer Exam 2026
 Candidates should carry the necessary documents to the examination centre for identity verification. The required items include:
 Printed copy of the RPSC Protection Officer Admit Card 2026
 Original Aadhaar Card with a recent, clear photograph
 Another original photo ID, such as a Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence, if required
 Recent colour photograph, if specified in the examination instructions
 Candidates should follow the identity proof and document requirements mentioned on their individual admit cards. Candidates can also check how to request a refund for a PW batch , including refund policy details and the batch change process.
